text:
Marta (People Ops): Quick thread 5 Harper Lee starts Mon (hybrid). Two things: I-9 needs scheduling and laptop shipment shows 'delayed' by carrier. Need plan.
Harper Lee (new hire): Morning! I can do the office kiosk on Monday afternoon or virtual I-9 if allowed. Also saw the tracking note ":package: delayed"  worried about Day-1 laptop.
Noah (Hiring Ops): Kiosk is easiest for hybrid folks. Which office are you nearest to? We can reserve a 15-min slot.
Harper Lee (new hire): I'm in Seattle. Can I use the Seattle kiosk?
Marta (People Ops): Yes. Seattle kiosk open 9-5. I'll reserve 2pm PT slot Monday and add calendar invite.
IT-Dispatch: FYI laptop label says "Exception - address verification". Carrier suggests hold for pickup at local hub. Harper, do you want us to redirect to office pickup or resend to home?
Harper Lee (new hire): Office pickup at the Seattle site would be great. I'll be there after the kiosk.
IT-Dispatch: Got it. I'll change delivery to hold-for-pickup at local FedEx hub and route to Seattle office if needed. Imaging note: we'll ship with standard profile, no admin until clearance.
Oliver (Backgrounds): Background intake showed SSN mismatch (last 4 vs doc). Harper, can you re-upload SSN card photo and a utility bill with current address? That will speed manual review.
Harper Lee (new hire): Re-uploading SSN card now, and uploading a recent utility bill.
Rosa (Payroll): Payroll note: if SSN is delayed, we can provisionally set tax withholding to single until SSN provided, but you'll need to submit the SSN for final payroll tax mapping.
Kris (Security): Security checklist: we require I-9 clearance or verified authorized rep + background cleared before granting VPN and admin. Badge can be issued for office pickup only after ID check at kiosk.
Marta (People Ops): Harper: kiosk + SSN upload -> we can probably clear same day. I'll mark "i9_in_progress" in tracker and badge on-hold until clearance.
Harper Lee (new hire): Kiosk booked at 2pm PT Monday. SSN + bill uploaded. Thanks.
IT-Dispatch: Carrier updated: package at FedEx hub Seattle - scheduled for hold for pickup. I've set the recipient as "Harper Lee - hold". Tracking 1Z999AA10123456784.
Noah (Hiring Ops): Harper  when you pick up at FedEx, show ID and badge QR; Marta will enable pickup badge.
BadgeBot: Temporary pickup pass created for harper.lee@redwood.com - valid 48 hours from ETA. QR sent. :white_check_mark:
Oliver (Backgrounds): Manual review done - SSN confirmed after re-upload. Background cleared (soft). Will mark full clear after I-9 completed.
Harper Lee (new hire): Quick update from kiosk: HR verified my ID, scanned docs, and signed Section 2. All good. I picked up the package at the hub and tested the laptop - boots fine. Thanks!
IT-Dispatch: Glad it arrived. Reminder: admin and VPN still locked until People Ops flips the "i9_cleared" flag. We'll enable standard dev groups once set.
Kris (Security): Confirmed kiosk attestation scanned and stored. Once People Ops hits clear, we'll add VPN group and re-evaluate admin needs.
Marta (People Ops): Everything looks green: background = cleared, I-9 = completed, laptop = received. Marking thread closed after payroll sets SSN in the system.
Rosa (Payroll): SSN added to payroll  tax forms updated. Welcome aboard Harper!
Harper Lee (new hire): Thanks everyone 44b thrilled to be here. See you on orientation!
